title: Junior Eurovision Song Contest 2026
metaDescription: Junior Eurovision Song Contest 2026 takes place in Ta' Qali, Malta, on 24 October, hosted by Public Broadcasting Services.
affiliateDisclosure: OneSliders may earn a commission when a booking is completed through a listed partner.
airportTransfer: Malta International Airport says public buses depart from outside the terminal, while prepaid taxis are available from its Welcomers' Hall.
arrivalWindow: Arrive before the 21:00 CEST live show on Saturday 24 October.
flightTip: Check your airline directly for current flight options to Malta, as advised by Malta International Airport.
stayGuidance: The official contest announcement confirms Ta' Qali as the venue area; confirm accommodation and venue-access arrangements before reserving.
bookingAdvice: The organiser says further event details will be announced; use its official channels for the latest visitor information.
transportTip: Use Malta Public Transport's Ta' Qali route planner
transportDetail: Malta Public Transport lists airport route 214 and routes 404 and 405 among services for Ta' Qali; check live schedules before travelling.
eventDayTip: The live show starts at 21:00 CEST.
eventDayDetail: Sixteen participating broadcasters will take the stage, and the official Junior Eurovision YouTube channel will carry the live show.
nextEditionDetail: 24 October at the Malta Fairs & Conventions Centre in Ta' Qali.
entryDetail: Follow Junior Eurovision's official Malta 2026 channels for the latest visitor and event details.

overview.about: The Junior Eurovision Song Contest is the children's version of Eurovision, an annual televised competition for young singers aged 9 to 14 representing their countries. Run by the European Broadcasting Union since 2003, it mirrors the main contest's format on a smaller, family-friendly scale.
overview.nextEvent: The next Junior Eurovision Song Contest is broadcast live from the host country, with each participating nation fielding a young solo singer or group. Viewers and national juries combine to decide the winner.
